paragraphs.text: Read pi-harness2 lessons from Pi and DeepSeek Harness
Read the project-local lessons produced by `pi-harness2` from either Pi or DeepSeek Harness. Both ad
apters register the same read-only `h2_lessons` model tool. The tool ranks matching task names and s
ummaries first, returns at most three lessons, and caps each at 4,000 characters. It never writes a
The `verified` field in a pi-harness2 lesson records its own LLM judge's verdict. The tool labels it
**self-judged pass**, not independent verification. Treat returned files as evidence to inspect, no
Both agents must use the project directory that contains `.harness2/library/`. Run `h2:run` in pi-ha
rness2 first to create a lesson; then ask either agent to call `h2_lessons` with task terms. The DSH
profile loads the supplied `cordis.patch.yml` on its next launch.
This is a small cross-runtime experience reader, not the full Harness² propose → probe → compose exe
cutor. It performs no model calls or probes by itself.
